requirements:
# Mechanical Arm Control - **Difficulty:** Hard (hard) ## Requirements Design a PLC program to control an automated mechanical arm that performs handling tasks on the production line. The mechanical arm has six basic actions: down, up, left, right, grip, and release. The operating modes of the mechanical arm include four types: manual, single step, single cycle, and continuous. Control requirements: 1. Manual mode: Allows the operator to control each action of the mechanical arm individually through the control panel, provided it is not yet in position. For example, pressing the down button (DownButton=1), if not at the down position (DownLimitSwitch=0), then move down (MoveDown=1); if at the down position (DownLimitSwitch=1), stop moving down. Releasing the down button also stops the movement down. 2. Single step mode: The mechanical arm automatically executes one action according to the preset program, and the operator needs to confirm after each action is completed to execute the next action. The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left. When the start button is pressed once, the mechanical arm executes the down command MoveDown, and stops after reaching the down position. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the grip command ActivateGrip, and stops after gripping. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the up command MoveUp, and stops after reaching the up position. When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the right command MoveRight, and stops after reaching the right position. When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the down command MoveDown, and stops after reaching the down position. When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the release command ActivateRelease, and stops after releasing. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the up command MoveUp, and stops after reaching the up position. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the left command MoveLeft, and stops after reaching the left position. Then starts the cycle again from the beginning 3. Single cycle mode: The mechanical arm automatically completes a full handling cycle, including all preset actions, and stops at the end of the cycle waiting for the operator's instruction. The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left, when the start button is pressed: The mechanical arm first moves down, then grips after reaching the down position, moves up after gripping, moves right after reaching the up position, moves down after reaching the right position, releases after reaching the down position, moves up after releasing, moves left after reaching the up position, and stops after reaching the left position. 4. Continuous mode: The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left, when the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm continuously executes the handling cycle of the single cycle mode. 5. The emergency stop function can stop all actions of the mechanical arm at any time. Use GripLimitSwitch and ReleaseLimitSwitch as the completion feedback for gripping and releasing respectively. The caller keeps the four mode-selection inputs mutually exclusive. ## Interface Definition | Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Input | `ManualMode` | `BOOL` | Manual mode | | Input | `SingleStepMode` | `BOOL` | Single step mode | | Input | `SingleCycleMode` | `BOOL` | Single cycle mode | | Input | `ContinuousMode` | `BOOL` | Continuous mode | | Input | `EmergencyStop` | `BOOL` | Emergency stop signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered | | Input | `Start` | `BOOL` | Start operation | | Input | `DownButton` | `BOOL` | Down button | | Input | `UpButton` | `BOOL` | Up button | | Input | `LeftButton` | `BOOL` | Left button | | Input | `RightButton` | `BOOL` | Right button | | Input | `GripButton` | `BOOL` | Grip button | | Input | `ReleaseButton` | `BOOL` | Release button | | Input | `DownLimitSwitch` | `BOOL` | Down position limit switch | | Input | `UpLimitSwitch` | `BOOL` | Up position limit switch | | Input | `LeftLimitSwitch` | `BOOL` | Left position limit switch | | Input | `RightLimitSwitch` | `BOOL` | Right position limit switch | | Input | `GripLimitSwitch` | `BOOL` | Grip position limit switch | | Input | `ReleaseLimitSwitch` | `BOOL` | Release position limit switch | | Output | `MoveDown` | `BOOL` | Down command | | Output | `MoveUp` | `BOOL` | Up command | | Output | `MoveLeft` | `BOOL` | Left command | | Output | `MoveRight` | `BOOL` | Right command | | Output | `ActivateGrip` | `BOOL` | Grip command | | Output | `ActivateRelease` | `BOOL` | Release command |

interface.name: EmergencyStop
interface.description:
Emergency stop signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: Emergency stop overrides every mode and request.
Opposed directions and grip/release are mutually exclusive.
A reached position suppresses its own command immediately.
assumptions: EmergencyStop=FALSE cancels the sequence and outputs while retaining non-empty mode selection in arm_mode; changing mode later clears outputs and resets the sequence, and recovery requires a fresh Start rising edge from top-left pose (UpLimitSwitch & LeftLimitSwitch).
A Start press is a rising edge. Start edges during an active action are ignored; edge history still updates.
No selected mode means all commands off and sequence reset. Changing mode also resets the sequence.
Opposing manual commands on an axis or grip pair are both inhibited. Independent non-opposing actions may run together.
Manual commands are combinational and stop on their matching limit/feedback. Contradictory limit switches are outside the caller contract.

Only one phase transition occurs per invocation. In cycle modes, completion feedback switches to the next command in that scan; an already-active next limit suppresses its command but is processed as completion on the next invocation.
Single-step completion switches all outputs off; the next action requires a fresh Start edge on a later scan.
Continuous completion of left movement wraps to down in the same scan. Single-cycle completion returns to idle.

At the start of a new automatic sequence (action 1, not every individual single step), UpLimitSwitch and LeftLimitSwitch must both be TRUE. Grip and release complete on the supplied feedback switches.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

V2 mode-change priority: emergency stop first; then a change of mode after the first invocation clears sequence/latches and suppresses commands for that invocation; edge memories still update. The first invocation establishes the selected mode and executes normally. New commands are accepted on subsequent invocations subject to their edge rules.
The four mode inputs (ManualMode, SingleStepMode, SingleCycleMode, ContinuousMode) are mutually exclusive per scan (<=1 TRUE; >1 rejected with ValueError).

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

atomic_propositions.no_mode: none of the four mode selectors TRUE
atomic_propositions.exclusive: NOT(MoveDown AND MoveUp) AND NOT(MoveLeft AND MoveRight) AND NOT(ActivateGrip AND ActivateRelease)
atomic_propositions.down_manual: ManualMode AND DownButton AND NOT UpButton AND NOT DownLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.step_done: SingleStepMode AND pre-busy AND matching completion feedback
atomic_propositions.waiting: SingleStepMode AND NOT pre-busy AND NOT rising(Start)
atomic_propositions.cycle_done: SingleCycleMode AND pre-phase LEFT AND LeftLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.continuous_done: ContinuousMode AND pre-phase LEFT AND LeftLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.begin_next: post-phase DOWN with command gated by DownLimitSwitch
atomic_propositions.feedback: matching completion feedback for the pre-action is TRUE
atomic_propositions.start: fresh Start edge in idle with top-left pose and selected automatic mode
atomic_propositions.ordered: the next accepted automatic phase follows DOWN, GRIP, UP1, RIGHT, DOWN2, RELEASE, UP2, LEFT
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehaviorV2:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB019(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehaviorV2[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
八动作顺序为下/夹/上/右/下/松/上/左。安全失去或无模式全关复位（急停期间仍记录当前非空模式选择），其次模式变化当拍全关复位；四模式选择互斥不可同拍并发。手动六命令分别=本按钮 & !反向按钮 & !本限位。单步完成时全关、保存下一步，新Start沿再启动；首步要求上左到位。单周期末回IDLE；连续末回第一步；自动只在本动作匹配限位时推进一阶，输出按转移后动作并由本限位门控。Start历史每拍更新。

atomic_propositions.MoveLeft: O[k].MoveLeft: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.MoveRight: O[k].MoveRight: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.ActivateGrip: O[k].ActivateGrip: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.ActivateRelease: O[k].ActivateRelease: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.all_auto_steps_valid: SingleStepMode and SingleCycleMode/ContinuousMode execute each step 1..8 cleanly with matching command & feedback only.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.MoveDown=false, O_init.MoveUp=false, O_init.MoveLeft=false, O_init.MoveRight=false, O_init.ActivateGrip=false, O_init.ActivateRelease=false.

ltl.description: Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.
ltl.explanation: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).

ltl.name: Safety
ltl.explanation: No command survives emergency stop or no mode.

ltl.name: Interlocks
ltl.explanation: Opposed actuators are never commanded together.

ltl.name: Manual down
ltl.explanation: Manual down requires the button and an unreached lower limit.

ltl.name: Reached limits
ltl.explanation: Every corresponding completion input suppresses its command.

ltl.name: Step wait
ltl.explanation: A completed single step waits for another press.

ltl.name: Automatic start
ltl.explanation: A permitted fresh start begins down.

ltl.name: Order
ltl.explanation: The eight preset actions retain their required order.

ltl.name: Conditional liveness
ltl.formula: (G(safe & SingleCycleMode) & G(busy -> F feedback)) -> G(started -> F idle)
ltl.explanation: With unchanged safe single-cycle mode and eventual matching feedback, every started sequence eventually returns idle.

ltl.description: Manual mode drives Up/Left/Right/Grip/Release with opposing-button & limit interlocks, and modeChanged forces all six outputs off.
ltl.explanation: Completes manual-mode and mode-change output coverage beyond MoveDown.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

tests.purpose: Manual hold-to-run, reached limits, opposing requests and emergency priority.

tests.name: single_step
tests.purpose: Each new step requires a release and fresh start; held start cannot skip grip.

tests.name: single_cycle
tests.purpose: All eight actions complete once and wait at top left.

tests.name: continuous
tests.purpose: The eighth completion wraps immediately to the first action.

tests.name: emergency_reset
tests.purpose: Emergency cancels an action; releasing emergency does not auto-restart.

tests.description: Mode switching off, manual Up/Left/Grip/Release + opposing interlock, non-top-left start rejection, full SingleStepMode 8-step cycle & wrap, and E-stop + mode change recovery.

specification_contract.observation: I[k] is sampled before execution; O[k] is observed after execution. Initial conditions apply before invocation zero.
specification_contract.normative_completion:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB019(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehaviorV2[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
八动作顺序为下/夹/上/右/下/松/上/左。安全失去或无模式全关复位（急停期间仍记录当前非空模式选择），其次模式变化当拍全关复位；四模式选择互斥不可同拍并发。手动六命令分别=本按钮 & !反向按钮 & !本限位。单步完成时全关、保存下一步，新Start沿再启动；首步要求上左到位。单周期末回IDLE；连续末回第一步；自动只在本动作匹配限位时推进一阶，输出按转移后动作并由本限位门控。Start历史每拍更新。
specification_contract.history_binding: I, O and Sref namespaces, initialization and updates are defined in normalized_specification.observation, history_bindings and reference_state_initial. Candidate output never drives Sref.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Versioned executable scan predicate plus LTL over interpreted predicates. No native checker encoding or completed formal proof is claimed.
specification_contract.transition_binding: Use normalized_specification.transition and exact pinned source snapshots.

normalized_specification.language: LTL over typed scan predicates; finite conjunction is a binding-time macro, not native NuSMV syntax.

transition.reference_binding: Persistent plc_agent.scan_contract.ScanContract('PUB019'); constructed once per independent case, current state is Sref[k].
transition.state_update: Exactly once per scan; mutations of sampled IN_OUT copies are reference effects, not observations.
transition.hash_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; all line endings normalized to LF before SHA256

comparison.integer_boolean: exact type and value; no tolerance
comparison.float: finite; abs error<=1e-5; dictionary/list shape and non-float values exact
comparison.PUB008: only successfully converted channels[j].outputValue: abs<=1e-5 OR rel<=2e-6; all preserved/config fields exact
comparison.PUB017: Successful deletion constrains recipeID=0; other fields of that deleted slot are unconstrained for the deletion scan. Subsequent no-write scans preserve the sampled actual representation. This observer history is separate from the logical reference database.
comparison.TIME_LTIME: exact integer nanoseconds after IEC literal parsing
comparison.implementation: plc_agent.normalized_spec.NormalizedScanMonitor.step with output_matches (pinned sources); observer histories never drive the independent logical reference

observation.I[k]: deep-copied inputs immediately before invocation k
observation.O[k]: actual outputs immediately after invocation k, supplied by independent execution backend
observation.Sref[k]: independent reference state BEFORE k; unrelated to similarly named candidate variables
observation.initial: fresh instance BEFORE invocation 0; never substituted by O[0]
observation.X: next scan-sequence position; argument must be Boolean, not a numeric term
observation.time: dt_ms is observed elapsed time; public timers use physical time, SELF Tick/count timers use logical scans

auxiliary_state_bindings.Spre: Sref[k], before the invocation; initialized by reference_state_initial
auxiliary_state_bindings.Spost: Sref[k+1], after exactly one pinned transition on I[k]
auxiliary_state_bindings.first: k=0 (first invocation); distinct from the pre-invocation initial observation
auxiliary_state_bindings.pre-output: actual O[k-1] for OUTPUT (explicit history initial where declared); I[k] for caller-owned IN_OUT
auxiliary_state_bindings.previous-input: I[k-1] for k>=1; edge memory for BOOL requests initially FALSE and updated after EVERY invocation
auxiliary_state_bindings.reference_warning: Spre/Spost predicates are input-driven ghosts, not evidence that candidate internals match. Conclusions about the candidate must constrain actual O.
auxiliary_state_bindings.modeChanged: Spre.process_contract.arm_mode is not None AND differs from selected input mode (manual/single_step/single_cycle/continuous/None)

normalized_specification.reference_state_rule: Initial state is the serialized constructor above; all fields update solely through the pinned transition. Ghost phase/history/queue are names for this state, not observed candidate state.

primitives.bitwise: DWORD AND/NOT and popcount operate on unsigned 32-bit values; complement is masked by 0xFFFFFFFF.
primitives.time_literals: IEC TIME/LTIME literals are exact integer durations in nanoseconds.
primitives.observed_arrays: All IN_OUT inputs are snapshots before invocation; outputs are independently acquired after invocation. Physical bounds map by ordinal, never share another array lower bound.
primitives.boolean_next: X takes a Boolean formula. Numeric history transport is bit-expanded for DWORD; Boolean histories use equivalence.
primitives.time_progress: Timed eventuality clauses explicitly require G(F(TimeTick)); TimeTick denotes crossing a new integer-ms boundary. Finite observations cannot establish this premise.

assumptions: EmergencyStop=FALSE cancels the sequence and outputs while retaining non-empty mode selection in arm_mode; changing mode later clears outputs and resets the sequence, and recovery requires a fresh Start rising edge from top-left pose (UpLimitSwitch & LeftLimitSwitch).
A Start press is a rising edge. Start edges during an active action are ignored; edge history still updates.
No selected mode means all commands off and sequence reset. Changing mode also resets the sequence.
Opposing manual commands on an axis or grip pair are both inhibited. Independent non-opposing actions may run together.
Manual commands are combinational and stop on their matching limit/feedback. Contradictory limit switches are outside the caller contract.

Only one phase transition occurs per invocation. In cycle modes, completion feedback switches to the next command in that scan; an already-active next limit suppresses its command but is processed as completion on the next invocation.
Single-step completion switches all outputs off; the next action requires a fresh Start edge on a later scan.
Continuous completion of left movement wraps to down in the same scan. Single-cycle completion returns to idle.

At the start of a new automatic sequence (action 1, not every individual single step), UpLimitSwitch and LeftLimitSwitch must both be TRUE. Grip and release complete on the supplied feedback switches.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

V2 mode-change priority: emergency stop first; then a change of mode after the first invocation clears sequence/latches and suppresses commands for that invocation; edge memories still update. The first invocation establishes the selected mode and executes normally. New commands are accepted on subsequent invocations subject to their edge rules.
The four mode inputs (ManualMode, SingleStepMode, SingleCycleMode, ContinuousMode) are mutually exclusive per scan (<=1 TRUE; >1 rejected with ValueError).

normalized_specification.domain_policy: Declared interface types and task assumptions apply. The pinned transition defines numeric/timing domains and rejects unsupported inputs. Reference exceptions are DOMAIN_OR_TOOL_ERROR, never candidate FAIL or PASS. Fairness/time-divergence assumptions concern infinite paths and are not proven by finite observations.
limitations: No ST-to-model translation or infinite-trace proof is implemented here.
Focused legacy LTL predicates still require backend lowering; normalization is not model-checker acceptance.
Finite matching cannot establish liveness or validate runtime provenance.
normalized_specification.rules_zh: 八动作顺序为下/夹/上/右/下/松/上/左。安全失去或无模式全关复位（急停期间仍记录当前非空模式选择），其次模式变化当拍全关复位；四模式选择互斥不可同拍并发。手动六命令分别=本按钮 & !反向按钮 & !本限位。单步完成时全关、保存下一步，新Start沿再启动；首步要求上左到位。单周期末回IDLE；连续末回第一步；自动只在本动作匹配限位时推进一阶，输出按转移后动作并由本限位门控。Start历史每拍更新。
